d:
Delhi ke Malcha Mahal mein ek aisa khaufnaak raaz dafan hai, jise chhedne ki keemat Aarya ko chukani padti hai. November 2018 mein, Ali Raza ki maut ki investigation karne pahunchi crime documentarian Aarya ko mahal ke andar ajeeb awaazein, insaani haddiyan aur khoon se latpat heere milte hain. Lekin sabse khaufnaak hai Wilayat Mahal ki rooh, jo daawa karti hai ki use maara gaya tha. Ab Aarya ke liye is khamosh mahal se bachkar nikalna bhi ek saza ban chuka hai.
Aakhir Wilayat ke saath kya hua tha, aur Aarya ko uske raaz ki talaash ki kya keemat chukani padegi?
Dekhiye Sannata
